content.short: HowRare.is provides rarity insights for Solana NFTs along with market stats and analytics.
content.description: Launched in 2021 and founded by SOLBigBrain, HowRare.is helps users understand how rare Solana NFTs are. On the main page, you can browse every NFT collection and inspect key metrics such as floor price, total items, holders, items on sale, the percentage on sale, and the floor market cap in USD. For developers, the API provides access to data endpoints covering collections, drops, rarity, and related analytics. The platform presents this information in a clear, accessible way to support decision making and rarity evaluation across Solana NFT projects.
